Where 🌍 reads as world-coded generic energy and 🏳️ reads as flag-coded universal energy, the Taiwan flag captures the moment when the sender wants to communicate Taiwanese-coded energy - a "Taiwan pride" tag or a "Taiwan-coded" reveal.

The flag cue borrows from national tradition and the modern Taiwanese-coded aesthetic, which is exactly why the emoji reads as Taiwanese-coded rather than literal.

What separates the Taiwan flag from the rest of the flag family is the specific Taiwan register. The emoji is not saying 'flag in general' (🏳️) or 'rainbow-coded' (🏳️‍🌈). It is saying 'Taiwan,' which carries a specific national, cultural, and Taiwanese-coded specificity.
